label: Ship From (Salesforce code)
notes: Values MAIN / SM-PA1 / FBA-US; must match TC_Warehouse__c.NFY_Code__c; required on the form

label: Carrier
notes: UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL eCommerce, OnTrac, Amazon Logistics

label: Workato Shipment Payload
notes: Body of the shipment webhook (non-ShipStation warehouses)

label: NFY ShipStation Payload
notes: ShipStation createorder body; False when not eligible

label: Final Destination (in-transit transfer)
notes: Set on a transfer into Inter-warehouse transit

label: Inbound Shipment Ref
notes: Set automatically on the receipt created from transit

label: Salesforce Warehouse Code
notes: Set only on the top location of each Salesforce warehouse; children inherit

label: Ships with ShipStation
notes: Deliveries from this location (or below) go to ShipStation

label: NFY Stock Payload
notes: False when the move is not sent

label: NFY Payment Snapshot
notes: Customer payments changed in the last 7 days
